test_title: PYST 49: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All forks are spoons.

Some forks are caps.

Conclusions (I): Some spoons are caps.

Conclusions (II): All caps are forks.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0288253b3745225ca02c84616ab3f65e5b8ac359c6e7d7a0b4d13bda667ac2e.png] 

Conclusions (I): Some spoons are caps. - True ( Some caps are spoons and Some spoons are caps is True)

Conclusions (II): All caps are forks. - False ( Some caps are spoons. All forks are spoons. All caps are forks is may be possible, but not definite. Hence, it is false.)

Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
